home.purpose: Entry page; preflight lands here when the eBay tab is elsewhere.

search.purpose: Search results (query in URL params: _nkw, LH_BIN, LH_Sold, _udlo/_udhi, _stpos ZIP, _pgn page).
search.notes: Exact matches come first; after the 'Results matching fewer words' divider eBay fills the page with loosely related items - those are ignored.

item.purpose: Listing page: price, condition, shipping to the ZIP, returns, seller card, item specifics, photos.

description.purpose: The seller's description, served in iframe#desc_ifr from another origin; opened directly to read it.
